learning_goal: Enable Grade 7 learners to understand and apply the central ideas of Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical.

explanation_sections.title: Activate
explanation_sections.explanation: Connect the chapter to prior knowledge, observation or experience.

explanation_sections.title: Build
explanation_sections.explanation: Teach from the source-grounded points and examples.
source_evidence: Changes Around Us: 5 Physical and Chemical I placed a cube of ice here half an hour ago.
A bud that I saw yesterday on this rose plant has become a ﬂower today.
Yesterday, I saw some brown spots on a banana, but today it has more brown spots and a strong smell.
Some of them are listed in Table 5.1, you may notice that something is changing in each case.
Any other Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 7 You might have noticed that these changes could be in the size, shape, smell, or other property of the substance or object.

explanation_sections.title: Reason
explanation_sections.explanation: Ask learners to explain relationships, evidence, patterns or steps.

explanation_sections.title: Transfer
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from the textbook context to a closely related new situation.

misconceptions: Confusing an example with the underlying concept.
checks_for_understanding: What changes if an important condition changes?
closure: Learner states the central idea, supporting evidence and one application.
